* This card has the Rep's species in all card states, including while in hand, Reserve Deck, etc.
* This card has the Rep's species even while its gametext is canceled.
* When retrieving multiple Force, the once per turn action may respond to any one individual unit of retrieved Force.
* This card is non-unique and counts as a non-unique alien of your Rep's species for flipping [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive{{!}}My Kind Of Scum]].
* Cards with multiple warrior icons can still only escort one captive at a time.

|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 of [[Alien Mob]] (version 3 of 3). The image here is the current Players Committee card image published 30 December 2024. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source.
* '''Original''' ([[Alien Mob]]): Virtual Set 16 release; card image first published 3 September 2021<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/alienmob.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/alienmob.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “This card has your Rep's species. When deployed, may retrieve a Rep or place a Rep stacked on your Objective in Used Pile. Once per turn, if Fearless And Inventive on table and you just retrieved Force, may place top card of Used Pile on Force Pile.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Alien Mob (Errata)]]): Card image published 1 June 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/alienmob.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/alienmob.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “This card has your Rep's species. When deployed, may retrieve a Rep or place a Rep stacked on your Objective in Used Pile. Once per turn, if Fearless And Inventive on table and you just retrieved Force, may place top card of Used Pile on Force Pile.” The PC published pixel-identical copies of this image on 5 July 2022 (file format change only; no visible change). '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image only: the PC re-rendered the Virtual Set 16 card images (the side credit and copyright lines and the typesetting of the game text changed; on some cards icons or the set-icon position also changed); the game text words are the same. A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Card image published 30 December 2024, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E2-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Dark/large/alienmob.gif</code> as published 30 December 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Dark/large/alienmob.gif holotable commit 9d2c01e] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “This card has your non-[Maintenance] Rep's species. When deployed, may place a Rep stacked on your Objective in Used Pile. Once per turn, if this card has your Rep's species and you just retrieved Force, may place top card of Used Pile on Force Pile.” '''What changed:''' Game text: “non-[Maintenance]” was added; “retrieve a Rep or” was removed; “Fearless And Inventive on table” became “this card has your Rep's species”.
